name: window-tiler
title: Window Tiler
description: Tile windows into grid, column, row, main-stack and spiral layouts, with include and exclude lists.
author: mearman

commands.name: tile-current-app
commands.title: Tile Current App Windows
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application.

commands.name: tile-desktop
commands.title: Tile Desktop Windows
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop.

commands.name: manage-lists
commands.title: Manage Tiling Lists
commands.description: Choose which applications are included in or excluded from tiling.

commands.name: tile-desktop-grid
commands.title: Tile Desktop Windows (Grid)
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop in the Grid layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-desktop-columns
commands.title: Tile Desktop Windows (Columns)
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop in the Columns layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-desktop-rows
commands.title: Tile Desktop Windows (Rows)
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop in the Rows layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-desktop-main-stack
commands.title: Tile Desktop Windows (Main and Stack)
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop in the Main and Stack layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-desktop-spiral
commands.title: Tile Desktop Windows (Spiral)
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop in the Spiral layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-current-app-grid
commands.title: Tile Current App Windows (Grid)
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application in the Grid layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-current-app-columns
commands.title: Tile Current App Windows (Columns)
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application in the Columns layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-current-app-rows
commands.title: Tile Current App Windows (Rows)
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application in the Rows layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-current-app-main-stack
commands.title: Tile Current App Windows (Main and Stack)
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application in the Main and Stack layout, ignoring the layout preference.

commands.name: tile-current-app-spiral
commands.title: Tile Current App Windows (Spiral)
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application in the Spiral layout, ignoring the layout preference.

preferences.name: gap
preferences.title: Gap
preferences.description: Space in points between windows and around the screen edge. Must be a non-negative number.

preferences.name: moveDuration
preferences.title: Move Duration
preferences.description: Milliseconds windows take to slide to their new position. 0 moves them instantly. Must be a non-negative number.

preferences.name: resizeDuration
preferences.title: Resize Duration
preferences.description: Milliseconds windows take to change size. 0 resizes them instantly. Must be a non-negative number.
